reason: My son or the neighbour already brings what I need, and the dekkene owner lets me pay at the end of the month. I don't see why I'd pay a fee and pay cash on the spot to someone I don't know.
objection: The dekkene gives me credit until month end and this wants cash or Whish each time, with $1.25 on every bag. I only get home from Jounieh after 6 and would have to catch the mini-market before it closes.
would_change_my_mind: If it was run by someone I know and let me pay at the end of the month like the dekkene, with no bag fee, and the saving on the slip was clearly more than I'd pay.
